# FG-AUTH-0026

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 401 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`portal-widgets`](../../ops/runbooks/portal-widgets.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_bad_portal_token_is_portal_token_invalid` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: ポータルからの呼び出しを確認できませんでした。問い合わせ番号を添えて管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The call from the portal could not be verified. Contact the administrator with the request ID.
- id: Panggilan dari portal tidak dapat diverifikasi. Hubungi administrator dengan menyertakan ID permintaan.

## 原因 (cause)

A request to a portal widget route (`/api/portal-widgets/v1/**`, ADR-0036) carried a Bearer token that is not a valid access token of the configured identity provider: not a JWT, or its signature, algorithm (`auth.oidc.signing_algs`), key (`kid` from the discovery JWKS), `iss` (`auth.oidc.issuer`), `exp` / `nbf` / `iat` (60 s skew), `typ` (when present `Bearer`), `azp` (required) or `sub` is wrong; or the widget routes are off (`portal.enabled = false`, `reason=portal_disabled`) or the sign-in is not configured (`reason=oidc_unconfigured`); or the request carried no Bearer token at all (`reason=bearer_required`: a cookie or Basic). The token's party (`azp`) and its roles are decided afterwards by authorize() (FG-AUTH-0003). Nothing was read.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event `forge.auth.token_rejected` with `scheme` and `reason` (the access token reasons of FG-AUTH-0025: malformed, alg_not_allowed, kid_missing, unknown_kid, key_invalid, key_alg_mismatch, signature, issuer, expired, not_yet_valid, missing_claim with `claim`, typ, subject, audience; or portal_disabled, oidc_unconfigured, bearer_required). The token and its claims are never logged. An identity provider that cannot be reached is FG-AUTH-0015 (503), not this code.

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook portal-widgets: check `portal.enabled`, that the portal and GitStation use the same realm (`auth.oidc.issuer`), the realm's signing algorithm and the server clock. `expired` from the portal means its own token refresh is late (portal side).
